verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can connect Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive so Claude can search emails, manage the calendar, and work with documents inside the conversation, with a stated no-training guarantee on that data. A connector directory and custom remote MCP connectors extend this to other tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connector search quality, and documented first-party connectors for non-Google drive/email/calendar providers.
